text_block_list.text: The day of the Debut Race—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It's finally time!
I don't feel like I'm gonna lose at all today!
choice_data_list: You seem to be in great spirits.
You look like you're in top form.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yup, 'cause I worked super hard in training,
and I ate a whole bunch of carrots too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: My tummy feels a little heavy from eating too much, but I'll be fine!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: My, so this is where you were.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Urara-chan, we came to cheer you on!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
King-chan and Spe-chan!
You came to watch!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I took the time to help you train,
so you better produce some real results.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yup, leave it to me!
I'll show you, I'm gonna take 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Do your best, Urara-chan!
As long as you remember what you learned during training, you'll be just fine!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Remember...? Yup, got it!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Like that time Spe-chan secretly ate snacks,
or when Spe-chan tripped and fell on the muddy track, right?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You don't need to remember stuff like that, geez!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Race 3 of the Debut Races will begin shortly.
All competing runners, please gather in the paddock."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's my turn!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Okaaaay! Watch me, Trainer!
Alrighty, off I gooo!
And so, Haru Urara's Debut Race finally began.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume aiming for the Twinkle Series
sprint across the dirt track.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: The pack is already stretching out thin, with Haru Urara running dead last.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
This isn't her holding back... It seems she's giving it everything she's got!
She's running with all her might, but she just can't close the gap to the front!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Do your best! Uraara-chaaan!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Keep running at full throttle until the very end!

text_block_list.name: Farmer
text_block_list.text: Urara-chaaan! Go, go, gooo!!

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Lady
text_block_list.text: Hang in thereee!!

The spectators, deeply moved by Haru Urara's earnest spirit,
cheer passionately for her race.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The leader crosses the finish line!
And the rest of the pack cascades right through behind them!

No matter how many times she lost, she never gave up and kept pushing forward.
And Haru Urara's finishing place was...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Amaaazing!! 9th place, that's a first for me!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Urara-chan!
That was an incredible race!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Indeed. It was all because you refused to give up until the very end.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: You never know what's gonna happen till the race is truly over!

text_block_list.name: Farmer
text_block_list.text:
You did great today too, Urara-chan.
I'll give you a whole basket of carrots later as a prize!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Yay!!
Now I've got plenty of energy for the next race!
Haru Urara's Debut Race concluded with her finishing 9th out of 10 runners.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
The Debut Race is all done now.
That was so much fun~.
choice_data_list: You worked really hard out there.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, 9th place! Ninth place! Woohoo!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
But you know, I feel like I can get 1st place next time!
Aww, I wish the next Debut Race was already here~.

Facing endless defeats yet still looking forward and pressing on
is something very few can ever do.

That must be why so many people are drawn to her.
...And without a doubt, I was one of them.
choice_data_list: Want to aim for 1st place together with me?
Would you like to aim for 1st place together with me?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh?! You'll train me again?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Scout me...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat! You're gonna scout me?!
For real real?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yay!!
I get to run in the Twinkle Series!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
If I can debut in the Twinkle Series,
I'll get to run in so many different races, right?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And if I do, I might even get a ton of 1st places!
Oooh, I can't wait!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on you, Trainer!
I'm gonna take lots and lots of 1st places, just you wait!!

And thus began our journey together with the boundless,
sunny optimism of Haru Urara.
